'''Malforia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> [[Exarch]] of Zakuul.

==Biography==
[[File:Malforia_in_her_cell.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Malforia in her cell on the Coil]]
An [[Exarch]] of Zakuul, Malforia commanded the [[Star Fortress]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. However, she was captured by the [[Spy/Legends|spymaster]] known as [[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]] after the destruction of [[Balmorran Star Fortress|her Fortress]]. She was held captive and studied for her fanatic personality at the Shroud's [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] base, [[The Coil (Obus VI)|the Coil]]. Later on, she was [[Escape from the Coil|discovered]] by [[HK-55]] and his companion [[Z0-0M]], the former who also had been held captive. Both HK-55 and Malforia were then taken by surprise when Zeeyo revealed herself to be a [[IR-9X Replicator Droid|replicator droid]], as she took on both HK and Malforia's appearances. Malforia then demanded to be released, desiring something to [[Death/Legends|kill]], and reasoned that they have a common foe.<ref name="KOTFE17" />

==Personality and traits==
Malforia was an individual known for her fanaticism, even among the Exarchs of Zakuul. She strictly followed the [[Old Ways (Zakuul)|Old Ways]] of Zakuul and adopted the the symbol of [[Tyth]], the god of rage, as her own personal sigil. Her philosophies guided her governance style. On her Star Fortress, she massacred more than thirty Balmorran officials in Tyth's name, earning her great infamy.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Exarch Malforia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Exarch Malforia only appeared in the Bonus Chapter, "Shroud of Memory" releases after the end of the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] for the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

===Gameplay alternatives===
The player, playing as HK-55, can decide Malforia's fate two ways:
[[File:Malforia_executed.jpg|thumb|250px|Malforia is electrocuted.]]
*The player can execute Malforia with her cell's disintegrator.
*The player accepts Malforia's aid and releases her. As the party takes an [[Space elevator|elevator]] to an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Malforia remarked that a [[Scions of Zakuul|Scion]] she was partnered with prophesized that she would ascend into the heavens beside a metal [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] to face her greatest test, after which she executed him on [[Arcann]]'s orders. Once the elevator reaches the top, Malforia spreads her arms, declaring that she's ready for her test, only for the door to open and flush her into the vacuum of space.
